activation_overhead.note: Multiple hidden/residual/attention/MoE scratch buffers plus CUDA graphs/NCCL/context; buffer lifetimes overlap variably. Not all illustrative buffers must be simultaneously resident.

cache_caveat: 576 bytes/token/layer latent+rope baseline; per-rank, not divided byTP. Add sparse indexer/scales/layout/block padding. Concurrent capture batch is conservative workload demand, not guaranteed peak residency; scheduler can serialize/preempt. Configured concurrency ceiling is not actual E74 demand.
caveats: Checkpoint bytes are disk representation, not an exact HBM map; Marlin repacking, replicated tensors and derived MLA weights affect it.

MTP layer78 may be skipped in ordinary inference, reducing checkpoint/4 estimate; no exact credit claimed without tensor-header accounting. This does not remove post-boot9.74GB clone at fixed.88 allocation.
Author~160GB/GPU on4B200 is reported allocation under memory utilisation, not a proven minimum footprint.
No new offload, lower-concurrency, reduced-cache or keep_base change is included; these would need a separately audited variant and cannot justify READY for the present package.
conclusion: No >=10% margin supported. Unchanged gpu_mem.88 profiles engine weights/activations/graphs and fills remainder with KV; subsequent keep_base=gpu clones about9.74GB per rank. Planning peak about133.8GB/rank under user141GB convention, leaving7.18GB/5.09% before other merge overhead. Real fit/OOM not measured; no READY or TP4H200 variant.
